# DevLeveler

> AI-Powered Developer Intelligence Platform

DevLeveler evaluates technical proof-of-work across public code repositories, resume keyword alignment, and project architecture to calculate an objective Developer Score, diagnose skill gaps against market demands, and recommend personalized 12-week learning milestones.

## Verified Core Capabilities
- Developer Score: Calculates a 0-100 composite score based on projects and code quality (30%), GitHub activity volume (25%), skill balance (20%), ATS resume compliance (15%), and deployment preparation (10%).
- GitHub Telemetry Analysis: Audits repository structure, commit consistency, language distribution, and code hygiene without requiring write access.
- ATS Resume Optimizer: Parses PDF resumes for automated OCR and ATS keyword compatibility against software engineering hiring standards.
- Skill Gap Diagnostics: Compares demonstrated tech stack against live market benchmarks to spotlight missing tools and architectural competencies.
- Personalized Career Roadmap: Generates ordered 12-week milestone curricula tailored to target engineering tracks (Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, DevOps).
- Developer Portfolio Audit: Evaluates portfolio websites for performance, mobile responsiveness, accessibility, and live demo proof-of-work.
